cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — swimming breaststroke; a quiet seaside tide pool bordered by smooth volcanic rock — catching a small white sunhat that has floated within reach after a light breeze; a sheltered picnic pavilion beside an ancient hillside plum orchard in clear spring daylight — laughing quietly after folding her plain white lunch napkin into a small bird; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — holds her keepsake at chest height; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; a rooftop drying terrace with laundry lines overhead — lying on her front; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — sitting on the ground; a Guan Yu temple — holds her keepsake up beside her face
